profile.headline: Software Engineer at Ready Computing
profile.summary: I work at the intersection of AI, product, and problem‑solving. Whether building fintech features, designing a platform for mobile phlebotomy businesses, or automating operational workflows, I use GenAI to explore ideas faster and deliver higher‑quality outcomes. I enjoy tackling ambiguous challenges, prototyping rapidly, and applying AI creatively—across tech, business, and innovation‑driven environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Leveraged Cline, Copilot, and ChatGPT to accelerate learning, coding, and end‑to‑end development for a next‑generation money‑movement product across both frontend and backend.
• Built an automated vulnerability‑patching workflow using GenAI, removing manual effort and streamlining testing.
• Led a team of four to a top‑three finish in a Generative AI Bootcamp by creating an AI‑powered merchant‑offer recommendation tool.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
• Designed and engineered a unified platform tailored for mobile phlebotomy businesses, improving workflow, scheduling, and service delivery.
• Used GenAI tools—leveraging Figma for rapid design and demo creation and Claude for fast prototyping and implementation—to accelerate product development.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description: Used ChatGPT to make an automatic scheduling tool, given the constraints of the housing department

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Collaborated in a team developing stretchable artificial skin electronics, gaining proficiency in soldering resistors, microprocessors, and voltage resistors for computer chips, and directly apprenticed under a post-Doctorate researcher.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Fellow
positions.description: Utilized Python-based stack to enhance memory capacity of novel recurrent neural network in research which was funded by Nakatani Foundation.
